array_semantics.command_argv_arrays: preserve exact original argument order; never sort
array_semantics.identifier_set_arrays: sort ascending by exact UTF-8 bytes; duplicate values forbidden

hash_self_reference_rule.hash_binding_location: a different provenance/checksum artifact or a checksum-bound verifier-output record
hash_self_reference_rule.hash_target: complete canonical UTF-8 JSON bytes of the artifact; the artifact contains no in-band self-hash field

numeric_canonicalization.integer_text: base-10 shortest representation; '-' allowed only for negative values

scope: future AEA01-AEA05 accounting evidence artifacts and associated freeze/verifier evidence only

string_canonicalization.comparison: exact Unicode scalar-value sequence; no trimming and no case folding
string_canonicalization.identifier_set_array_order: ascending lexicographic order of exact UTF-8 byte sequences
string_canonicalization.object_member_order: ascending lexicographic order of exact UTF-8 byte sequences of member names
